items.name: RDP
items.description: Read protection option byte. The read protection is used to protect the software code stored in Flash memory.

values.text: Level 0, no protection
or any value other than 0xAA and 0xCC: Level 1, read protection
Level 2, no debug

items.name: BOR_LEV
items.description: These bits contain the supply level threshold that activates/releases the reset. They can be written to program a new BOR level value into Flash memory

values.text: BOR Level 0, reset level threshold is around 1.7 V
BOR Level 1, reset level threshold is around 2.0 V
BOR Level 2, reset level threshold is around 2.2 V
BOR Level 3, reset level threshold is around 2.5 V
BOR Level 4, reset level threshold is around 2.8 V

No reset generated when entering Stop mode

No reset generated when entering Standby mode

No reset generated when entering the Shutdown mode

IWDG counter active in standby mode

values.text: nBOOT0 = 0

items.name: BOOT_LOCK
items.description: Unique boot entry point

values.text: This bit can be reset by SW only in level0. In level 1, an RDP level regression will reset this bit, which will force a mass erase of the flash.
the boot will be done from user flash only, whatever the RDP level
